records.jp: よし、全員揃ったな。<CR>お前たちに紹介したい人物がいる
records.en_original: All right, everyone's here. There's someone I want to introduce to you.
records.en: All right, everyone's here. There's someone I want to introduce to you.

records.jp: ＡＡＳＡから来ました！<CR>平原陽桜莉です
records.en_original: I'm from the AASA! My name's Hiori Hirahara!
records.en: I'm from the AASA! My name's Hiori Hirahara!

records.jp: ＡＡＳＡ……？
records.en_original: The AASA?
records.en: The AASA?

records.jp: まぁ……大まかな説明になるが
records.en_original: Well, let me give you a brief explanation.
records.en: Well, let me give you a brief explanation.

records.jp: 我々日ノ杜学園とは別団体だが、灰の撲滅という目的は<CR>共通している研究組織、といったところか
records.en_original: They're a separate group from us at Hinomori Academy, but the AASA is a research organization with the same goal of eradicating the Ash.
records.en: They're a separate group from us at Hinomori Academy, but the AASA is a research organization with the same goal of eradicating the Ash.

records.jp: 近頃、関連組織の動きが活発になってきていてな
records.en_original: Lately, related organizations have been becoming more active.
records.en: Lately, related organizations have been becoming more active.

records.jp: 既にＡＡＳＡ以外の組織や……あるいは、別の地区の<CR>学校からも、出雲に人員が派遣される予定になっている
records.en_original: Other organizations besides the AASA, and maybe even some schools from other districts, are going to be sending people to Izumo.
records.en: Other organizations besides the AASA, and maybe even some schools from other districts, are going to be sending people to Izumo.

records.jp: 今回、平原にここに来てもらったのは、<CR>お前たちに指導をするためだ
records.en_original: I asked Hirahara to come here this time to help train all of you.
records.en: I asked Hirahara to come here this time to help train all of you.

records.jp: 指導？
records.en_original: Train us?
records.en: Train us?

records.jp: コズミックファング奪還を目指すにあたり、<CR>お前たちの戦闘力向上は急務だ
records.en_original: If we're going to reclaim the Cosmic Fang, boosting your combat strength is top priority.
records.en: If we're going to reclaim the Cosmic Fang, boosting your combat strength is top priority.

records.jp: 一緒に任務に参加し、平原から戦闘技術を<CR>学んでほしい
records.en_original: You'll be working with her on missions, so I want you to learn combat skills from Hirahara.
records.en: You'll be working with her on missions, so I want you to learn combat skills from Hirahara.

records.jp: えへへ……あんまり期待されちゃうと<CR>困っちゃいますけど
records.en_original: Hehe... If you expect too much from me, I might get a little nervous!
records.en: Hehe... If you expect too much from me, I might get a little nervous!

records.jp: 精一杯頑張るので、よろしくお願いします！
records.en_original: I'll do all I can, so let's do our best together!
records.en: I'll do all I can, so let's do our best together!

records.jp: わ～！　よろしくね～！
records.en_original: Wow! Nice to meet you!
records.en: Wow! Nice to meet you!

records.jp: すごーい！！<CR>あんなにいたのに、全部一気に倒しちゃった！
records.en_original: Wow! There were so many of them, but you took them all out at once!
records.en: Wow! There were so many of them, but you took them all out at once!

records.jp: いや、今のはたまたまだから……
records.en_original: No, that was just a fluke just now...
records.en: No, that was just a fluke just now...

records.jp: それよりずっと気になってるんだけど、<CR>平原の見た目ってわたしたちと違くない？
records.en_original: Anyway, I've been wondering for a while—don't you think Hiori's appearance is kinda different from ours?
records.en: Anyway, I've been wondering for a while—don't you think Hiori's appearance is kinda different from ours?

records.jp: ああ、私も気になっていた。<CR>イローデッドに見られる特徴が無いようだが？
records.en_original: Yeah, I've noticed it too. She doesn't seem to have the same visual appearance as the Eroded.
records.en: Yeah, I've noticed it too. She doesn't seem to have the same visual appearance as the Eroded.

records.jp: ああ、私はイローデッドじゃなくて、<CR>リフレクターだから
records.en_original: Oh, that's because I'm not an Eroded—I'm a Reflector.
records.en: Oh, that's because I'm not an Eroded—I'm a Reflector.

records.jp: この指輪……ブルーリフレクションを使って<CR>変身してるの
records.en_original: This ring... I use this Blue Reflection to transform.
records.en: This ring... I use this Blue Reflection to transform.

records.jp: えっ、指輪で変身！？<CR>そんなの初めて聞いたんだけど！
records.en_original: Wait, you transform with a ring?! This is the first I've heard of anything like that!
records.en: Wait, you transform with a ring?! This is the first I've heard of anything like that!

records.jp: 一応、表向きには秘密だから……
records.en_original: Well, it's technically a secret from the public...
records.en: Well, it's technically a secret from the public...

records.jp: 我々イローデッドの存在と同様、ということか。<CR>それにしても……
records.en_original: So it's just like how we're supposed to keep the Eroded a secret. Still...
records.en: So it's just like how we're supposed to keep the Eroded a secret. Still...

records.jp: 戦闘指導を任されるだけあって、すごい実力だ。<CR>いったい、どうやって倒したんだ？
records.en_original: No wonder you're in charge of combat training—you're really amazing. How did you even beat them?
records.en: No wonder you're in charge of combat training—you're really amazing. How did you even beat them?

records.jp: えっと……<CR>ガッとして、すぱーんっ！　みたいな
records.en_original: Um... I just went bam, then wham! Like that.
records.en: Um... I just went bam, then wham! Like that.

records.jp: ガッとして、すぱーん………？
records.en_original: Bam and wham?
records.en: Bam and wham?

records.jp: え、えっと、グッと込めて、バッ！　かも……
records.en_original: Uh, um, maybe it was more like a boom then bam type situation! Or something...
records.en: Uh, um, maybe it was more like a boom then bam type situation! Or something...

records.jp: え、えっと……
records.en_original: U-um...
records.en: U-um...

records.jp: とにかく、残りの異灰も倒しちゃおう。<CR>みんなの実力も見せてほしいな！
records.en_original: Anyway, let's take out the rest of the Testa. I want to see everyone show their skills off too!
records.en: Anyway, let's take out the rest of the Testa. I want to see everyone show their skills off too!

records.jp: お疲れさま、陽桜莉先生
records.en_original: Nice work, Instructor Hiori.
records.en: Nice work, Instructor Hiori.

records.jp: 由紀子ちゃんまで、やめてってばー
records.en_original: You too, Yukiko? Come on, stop it!
records.en: You too, Yukiko? Come on, stop it!

records.jp: あはは、ごめんごめん
records.en_original: Ahaha, sorry, I couldn't help it!
records.en: Ahaha, sorry, I couldn't help it!

records.jp: ……それにしても、まさか日ノ杜であなたに<CR>会えるとは思わなかったなぁ
records.en_original: Still, I never expected to run into you here in Hinomori.
records.en: Still, I never expected to run into you here in Hinomori.

records.jp: うん、びっくりだよね
records.en_original: Yeah, it really was a surprise.
records.en: Yeah, it really was a surprise.

records.jp: 二人って、地元の知り合いなんだっけ？
records.en_original: Wait, you two know each other from back home?
records.en: Wait, you two know each other from back home?

records.jp: 共通の友人伝いの知り合い、って感じかな。<CR>実際に会ったのは今日が初めてだし
records.en_original: It's more like we have friends in common. Today's actually the first time we've met in person.
records.en: It's more like we have friends in common. Today's actually the first time we've met in person.

records.jp: でも、まさか戦闘指導員だなんて……。<CR>あれからも、色々あったみたいだね
records.en_original: But, I never would've guessed you were a combat instructor... Sounds like a lot's happened since then.
records.en: But, I never would've guessed you were a combat instructor... Sounds like a lot's happened since then.

records.jp: えへへ……実は月ノ宮で問題を解決した後、<CR>変身できなくなってたんだ
records.en_original: Hehe... Actually, after we solved the problem at Tsukinomiya, I couldn't transform for a while.
records.en: Hehe... Actually, after we solved the problem at Tsukinomiya, I couldn't transform for a while.

records.jp: けど、なんでかまた変身できるようになって。<CR>気づいたら、こんなことになってたって感じ
records.en_original: But then, for some reason, I was able to transform again. Before I knew it, this is where I ended up.
records.en: But then, for some reason, I was able to transform again. Before I knew it, this is where I ended up.

records.jp: 急にだったから、私も瑠夏ちゃんたちも<CR>ずっと不思議に思ってるんだ
records.en_original: It happened so suddenly, so both Ruka and I have been confused about it.
records.en: It happened so suddenly, so both Ruka and I have been confused about it.

records.jp: それって、灰の降る量が増えたからかな？
records.en_original: Do you think it's because more Ash has been falling lately?
records.en: Do you think it's because more Ash has been falling lately?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 灰の降る量……そうだ、そうだよ！<CR>たしかそれくらいからだったよ！
records.en_original: The increase in Ash... Yeah, that's right! I think it started around that time!
records.en: The increase in Ash... Yeah, that's right! I think it started around that time!

records.jp: すごいじゃん、かんな。<CR>どうしてわかったの？
records.en_original: That's amazing, Kanna. How did you figure it out?
records.en: That's amazing, Kanna. How did you figure it out?

records.jp: それはほら、えっと……ピンチの時に力を発揮するのが<CR>特撮ヒーローのお約束だから！
records.en_original: Well, umm... It's kind of the rule that special powers awaken in a pinch for tokusatsu heroes!
records.en: Well, umm... It's kind of the rule that special powers awaken in a pinch for tokusatsu heroes!

records.jp: あ、あやみんが呼んでるみたい。<CR>ちょっと行ってくるね！
records.en_original: Ah, looks like Ayamin's calling me. I'll be right back!
records.en: Ah, looks like Ayamin's calling me. I'll be right back!

records.jp: 特撮ヒーローかぁ……。<CR>それくらい、かっこよければよかったけど
records.en_original: A tokusatsu hero, huh? Wish I could be that cool.
records.en: A tokusatsu hero, huh? Wish I could be that cool.

records.jp: ……悩み事があるなら聞こうか？<CR>そういうの、ほら、ちょっと得意だし
records.en_original: If you want to talk about what's on your mind, I can listen. I'm kinda good at that stuff.
records.en: If you want to talk about what's on your mind, I can listen. I'm kinda good at that stuff.

records.jp: ふふ、そういえばそうだったね。<CR>まあ、そんなかっこいいものじゃないんだけど
records.en_original: Hehe, that's right, isn't it? It's nothing as cool as that, though.
records.en: Hehe, that's right, isn't it? It's nothing as cool as that, though.

records.jp: さっきの指導のこと。<CR>私、説明下手で擬音だらけになっちゃって……
records.en_original: It's about the training earlier. I'm so bad at explaining things, I ended up using nothing but sound effects to explain myself...
records.en: It's about the training earlier. I'm so bad at explaining things, I ended up using nothing but sound effects to explain myself...

records.jp: あー……、確かにちょっと多かったかな。<CR>みんなキョトンとした顔してたし
records.en_original: Oh... Yeah, maybe there were a few too many sound effects. Everyone looked kind of lost.
records.en: Oh... Yeah, maybe there were a few too many sound effects. Everyone looked kind of lost.

records.jp: やっぱりそうだよね。<CR>はぁ……みんなを困らせちゃったなぁ……
records.en_original: I thought so... Ugh, I guess I just confused everyone.
records.en: I thought so... Ugh, I guess I just confused everyone.

records.jp: 陽桜莉も、そういう悩みってあるんだ？<CR>ちょっと意外かも
records.en_original: Even you get worried about stuff like that? That's kind of a surprise.
records.en: Even you get worried about stuff like that? That's kind of a surprise.

records.jp: あるよー！<CR>私だって、何も考えてないわけじゃないよー！！
records.en_original: Of course! It's not like I just go around with a head full of air, you know!
records.en: Of course! It's not like I just go around with a head full of air, you know!

records.jp: ごめんごめん、そういう意味じゃなくて。<CR>なんか親近感あって嬉しいって話
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry, I didn't mean it like that. I just feel closer to you now—it's kinda nice.
records.en: Sorry, sorry, I didn't mean it like that. I just feel closer to you now—it's kinda nice.

records.jp: そうだ、それならこういうのはどうかな？
records.en_original: Right, then how about this?
records.en: Right, then how about this?

records.jp: ふぅ……どうにか無事に終えられたよ
records.en_original: Phew... Somehow, we managed to get through it safely.
records.en: Phew... Somehow, we managed to get through it safely.

records.jp: 三日間お疲れさま、陽桜莉。<CR>戦闘指導すごくよかったよ
records.en_original: You did great these last three days, Hiori. Your combat guidance was really helpful.
records.en: You did great these last three days, Hiori. Your combat guidance was really helpful.

records.jp: ううん、由紀子ちゃんがいたからこその<CR>大成功だよ！
records.en_original: No, it was a big success because you were there, Yukiko!
records.en: No, it was a big success because you were there, Yukiko!

records.jp: 私の擬音だらけの説明を、わかりやすい説明に<CR>翻訳してくれなかったら、どうなってたか……
records.en_original: If you hadn't translated my sound effect-filled explanations into something easier to understand, I don't know what would've happened.
records.en: If you hadn't translated my sound effect-filled explanations into something easier to understand, I don't know what would've happened.

records.jp: 力になれてよかった……。<CR>助けられてばっかりじゃ、格好つかないし
records.en_original: I'm glad I could help. It wouldn't feel right if I was always the one being helped.
records.en: I'm glad I could help. It wouldn't feel right if I was always the one being helped.

records.jp: この数日間で、みんなすごく強くなったよ。<CR>私が保証する
records.en_original: Everyone's gotten so much stronger in just a few days. I can promise you that.
records.en: Everyone's gotten so much stronger in just a few days. I can promise you that.

records.jp: コズミックファングも、きっと奪還できるよ。<CR>頑張ってね
records.en_original: I'm sure you can take back the Cosmic Fang, too. You've got this!
records.en: I'm sure you can take back the Cosmic Fang, too. You've got this!

records.jp: ……ありがとう。<CR>月ノ宮に帰ったら、都によろしく言っといて
records.en_original: Thank you. When you get back to Tsukinomiya, tell Miyako I said hi.
records.en: Thank you. When you get back to Tsukinomiya, tell Miyako I said hi.

records.jp: うん。次は月ノ宮で会えるといいね。<CR>それじゃあ！
records.en_original: Yeah. I hope we can meet back in Tsukinomiya next time. See you!
records.en: Yeah. I hope we can meet back in Tsukinomiya next time. See you!

records.jp: えっと、駅はあっちだから……
records.en_original: Let's see, the station is that way...
records.en: Let's see, the station is that way...
